thread:
lena: quick heads-up from the early-exit sampler bringup on ember-12b-int8. short prompts (~<20 tokens) show drop in factuality and some hallucination-like earlier exits. sharing brief repro + numbers.
arjun: can you paste the failing example and the sampler config?
lena: example prompt: "List two uses for baking soda in the kitchen."
ember-12b-fp32 (baseline sampling): "Baking soda can be used to neutralize odors and as a leavening agent in baking. It also works as a gentle cleaner for surfaces."
ember-12b-int8 + early-exit (threshold=0.85): "Baking soda can be used to neutralize odors and as a leavening agent. It can be used as a substitute..."  <-- cutoff mid-clause by exit, then adds unrelated sentence about storage.
felix: that's rough. do you have per-token exit probs? maybe quant noise makes the exit classifier overconfident earlier.
lena: pasted small stat table: 
```
fp32 baseline: ppl=10.8, exit_rate=0 (no early-exit), factual_score=0.92
int8 baseline (no early-exit): ppl=11.4, factual_score=0.89
int8 + early-exit(th=0.85): ppl=12.0, avg_len=9.3, exit_rate=18%, factual_score=0.76  <-- big drop
```
ciara: what is the early-exit model? learned classifier on hidden-states?
arjun: yes, it's a tiny binary classifier trained on float hidden states to predict completion certainty. was never quant-aware trained.
felix: two obvious suspects: (1) classifier weights don't survive int8 conversion, (2) cached KV quantization shifts hidden-state distribution causing classifier misfires.
infra-bot: artifact uploaded at s3://redwood-experiments/early-exit/6432108888/artifacts.tar.gz
lena: quick ablation done: keep exit-classifier in fp16 (no quant) while model in int8 -> exit_rate drops to 6%, factual_score up to 0.86. so classifier quantization is main driver.
ciara: nice signal. propose mitigations: (A) quant-aware fine-tune classifier (1 epoch) on quant-intro synthetic prefixes, (B) clamp exit threshold dynamically by prefix length (longer prefixes require slightly higher threshold), (C) add a small token-level second-stage verifier that vetoes exits for short prompts.
arjun: also consider temperature-smoothing on classifier logits before sigmoid to avoid cliff behavior.
felix: ran a toy sweep of threshold in {0.8,0.85,0.9} with fp16 classifier fallback: best tradeoff at 0.9 -> exit_rate 4%, factual_score 0.88, ppl ~11.6. this is promising.
ciara: we should not ship fp16 fallback by default because of perf implications on tiny endpoints. prefer quant-aware ft.
lena: agreed. next steps I propose: 
- run quant-aware fine-tune (classifier only) on 2k synthetic examples, evaluate on short-holdout N=1000
- run threshold sweep with and without kv-quantized cache to isolate cache effect
- compute token-level KL vs fp32 and produce surprise heatmap for first 12 tokens
- small human eval N=100 of short prompts focusing on truncation/bizarre exits
- add autoprobe to onboarding checklist: run classifier fp16 fallback check and report exit_rate_short_prompts
arjun: I'll take KL+heatmap job, felix can own the quant-ft job, ciara will set up the autoprobe.
infra-bot: job queued: infra-job-78432 (expected runtime ~2h)
felix: scheduling quant-ft now, will try 1 epoch + small LR 1e-5. will upload artifacts to the s3 path above.
ciara: i'll prototype the verifier veto for short prompts as a cheap interim guard.
lena: thanks all. tagging @eng-ml for visibility :eyes: — will update thread with results.
arjun: if quant-ft doesn't close gap we may need to retrain classifier with quantized-KV snapshots.
felix: noted. ETA EOD for initial artifacts.
